primary_objective: Make the visible upper body clearly and substantially slimmer at first glance while preserving same-person visual identity.

editable.shirt_drape: reconstruct over the slimmer body; preserve oversized/washed-shirt identity while removing unnecessary boxy bulk
editable.posture: may subtly recenter or lengthen torso
editable.occlusion: rebuild sleeves, arms, hands and phone relationships when needed

anchors: same black washed CALIFORNIA / LONG BEACH / SUNSET T-shirt identity and readable print
hard_rule: Naturalness is a final visual QA gate, not a limiter on slimming strength.
privacy: No portrait or control images belong in this public repository. Runtime assets are private/local.
